answer: Reaching eligibility takes 77 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. The fable register is checked at draw time, juniper lists the eligible set, and prism seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 77 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. A 352 account operation therefore ties up 28 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
